run_parallel_benchmarks: run the parallel benchmark suite for gtn compose, forward_score, and indexed functions with a configurable batch size
run_time_compose: run the parallel compose benchmark that times forward and backward passes for composing two lists of linear graphs
run_time_forward_score: run the parallel forward_score benchmark that times forward and backward passes for scoring a batch of linear graphs
run_time_indexed_func: run the parallel indexed function benchmark that times gtn.parallel_for over a batch of compose and forward_score operations
review_gtn_parallel_api: review the gtn parallel API usage including compose, forward_score, backward, and parallel_for across benchmark functions
